Facials in Barcelona

Deep facial cleanses, on their own or combined with dermaplaning, dermapen (microneedling) or radiofrequency. The cleanse removes impurities and dead cells; dermaplaning also takes off fine facial hair, and dermapen works the skin with micro-needles. Not sure which to choose? Message us and we'll guide you based on your skin.

Brows, lashes and lips

Brow design and shaping with threading or henna tint, brow lamination, and lash lift with tint. The lift curls and darkens your own lashes, with no extensions. Hidralips hydrates the lips with hyaluronic acid.

Bridal and occasion make-up

Professional make-up for brides and for events: weddings, dinners, parties or photo shoots. When you book, tell us the date and the look you have in mind.

Body treatments in Barcelona

Pressotherapy, massage, manual lymphatic drainage and back cleanses, plus body devices: HIFU 12D, radiofrequency, ultrasound, cold lipolaser, photon laser, vacuum therapy and electrostimulation. Most can be booked as a single session or as a pack of 4.

Manicure and pedicure in Eixample

Manicure and pedicure; the full pedicure includes gel polish. Reviews highlight the attention to detail and the advice on making the polish last.

When you arrive

Ring the bell and come up.

Don't look for a sign on the street: it's door 6 on the fifth floor. Ring, come up and walk in at your time.

Questions

Before you come.

How do I book?

By WhatsApp or phone, on +34 675 16 13 14. In the service menu you can tick what you want and send us the selection; we reply with a day and time.

Do I need to book in advance?

Yes. We work by appointment only, so message us before you come and we'll tell you the first free slot.

Where exactly are you?

At Carrer de la Diputació 238, 5th floor, door 6, 08007 Barcelona (Eixample), next to Rambla de Catalunya and 5 minutes from Passeig de Gràcia metro (L2, L3, L4). There is no sign on the street: ring the bell and come up.

Which facial treatments do you offer?

Deep facial cleanse, on its own or combined with dermaplaning, dermapen (microneedling) or radiofrequency; dermapen as a single session or a pack of 4; and Hidralips for the lips. Prices are in the menu.

Shall we save you a slot?

Tell us what you'd like done and which days suit you.
